origin.summoner.beastmaster.name: Summoner
origin.summoner.beastmaster.description: Real fighting companions: three battle wolves and an iron guard. They actively hunt villagers and hostile NPCs, fight for you, follow you and never hurt you. Cost: -2 hearts of max health.
power.summoner.summon_wolves.name: Summon Battle Wolves
power.summoner.summon_wolves.description: Primary: 3 battle wolves (60 HP / 10 damage / 10 armor / fire resist + strength). 30s cooldown.
power.summoner.summon_golem.name: Summon Iron Guard
power.summoner.summon_golem.description: Secondary: buffed iron golem (250 HP / 25 damage / knockback immune / resistance + regeneration). 45s cooldown.
